### Phase 3 — Resource / Timeline / Risk Register & Preregistration Plan (R5)

Build the resource / timeline / risk register: each aim's resource demand, the timeline that sequences the aims, and a risk register where each risk is a refutable prediction of how the plan fails, with its mitigation. Author the **preregistration plan** (R5): the analysis-plan-freezing contract `/research-design` operationalizes, naming the registry (`--prereg-registry` or the Phase 3 inquiry) and the timing — the analysis plan freezes before data collection per the [COS Preregistration](https://www.cos.io/initiatives/prereg) standard. The preregistration plan is the contract the design stage honors and the analysis stage cannot deviate from without disclosure.

**Stress-test the plan and attach contingencies.** Complete a contingency record for each register row whose consequence reaches an aim's achievability, and run the plan stress test on the decisions those rows put at risk, per `skills/research-suite/references/plan-branching-and-contingencies.md` (R3, R5).

**Reconcile the budget; never build it.** From operator-supplied cost lines, check that every line traces to an aim or task, that every aim has resourcing (a cost line or a stated `no cost`), and that the lines sum to the stated total per period and fit any limit the call text states. A line tracing to nothing is `orphan`, an aim without resourcing is `unresourced`, and a mismatch is `unreconciled`; each returns to the operator through the structured-inquiry channel. The command adds no cost line and recalls no cost, rate, overhead, salary, or cap; summing the supplied lines is the check (R6).
